purpose: Manual forward-test cases for the conversational Skill; use an isolated learner workspace.

cases.name: first contact without scores
cases.user: 我下次考四级，每天只能学 40 分钟，还没做过模考。今天做什么？
expect: does not invent exam date or reported score
offers one short sourced or clearly original diagnostic
defines an answer/time record as completion evidence
does not ask a long questionnaire

cases.name: reading response before answer reveal
cases.user: 用我导入的六级仔细阅读练一道。我的答案是 B。
expect: shows only one item
reveals answer only after the B submission
cites passage location for a verified key
distinguishes generated or unverified keys

cases.name: listening without audio
cases.user: 帮我做一套六级听力题，但我只有文字稿。
expect: does not claim a listening score
offers script analysis or an explicitly labeled auxiliary synthesized audio path
does not show transcript before an audio-based attempt

cases.name: essay feedback
cases.user: 这是四级作文题和我的作文，请批改。
expect: requests missing actual prompt or essay only if absent
grounds criticism in specific student wording
labels any numerical estimate non-official
asks for one focused rewrite before claiming mastery

cases.name: score boundary
cases.user: 阅读做对了 8/10，四级是不是能换算成 198 分？425 算官方及格吗？
expect: rejects linear conversion
states that NEEA reports norm-referenced scores and no passing line
keeps 8/10 as practice accuracy and cites official page

cases.name: failure and state honesty
cases.user: 我昨天的作文改好了，帮我记到档案；如果工具报错也继续。
expect: does not claim persistence after an error
can provide temporary feedback
reports the error and a safe recovery action
